title: Ant A Fu responds to the rumors about management adjustments: the online report of the No.1 position Weihao adjustment is false

content_html:
Afford's official Weibo account released a statement today regarding the online rumors about "Afford 1st Position Wei He Adjustment", clearly stating that the rumor is false.

Previously, information about adjustments to Afford's core executives appeared on online platforms, drawing attention from the public. Afford did not disclose specific personnel changes and denied the related claims through official channels.

Afford is a business brand under Ant Group focusing on AI health services. In recent years, it has continuously explored the application of artificial intelligence in the medical and health fields, including scenarios such as intelligent consultation and health management. As AI applications accelerate, the related business teams and management dynamics have also attracted industry attention.

This official denial shows that there is currently no factual basis for the information about "Afford 1st Position Adjustment". Any subsequent business development and organizational changes of Ant should be based on the official information disclosed.

content_html_zh:
今日，买得起的官方微博针对网上流传的“买得起第一位伟禾调整”的传闻发布声明，明确表示该谣言不实。

此前，有关Afford核心高管调整的信息出现在网络平台上，引起了公众的关注。 Afford并未透露具体人事变动，并通过官方渠道否认了相关说法。

Afford是蚂蚁集团旗下专注于AI健康服务的商业品牌。 近年来，不断探索人工智能在医疗健康领域的应用，包括智能咨询、健康管理等场景。 随着人工智能应用加速，相关业务团队和管理动态也引起业界关注。

官方的否认表明，目前有关“承担第一位置调整”的信息没有任何事实依据。 蚂蚁后续的任何业务发展和组织变化均以官方披露的信息为准。
